board: Adafruit ADT7410 High Accuracy I2C Temperature Sensor Breakout (#4089, STEMMA QT version)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico: the 6-pin header (VIN, GND, SCL, SDA, INT, CT) comes from Adafruit's board file, and the sim encodes the datasheet's 13-bit and 16-bit twos-complement formats, chosen by config bit 7. The driver selects 16-bit mode and decodes code/128.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit-ADT7410-PCB (Adafruit ADT7410 STEMMA QT.brd, JP1 pads 1-6) and https://learn.adafruit.com/adt7410-breakout/pinouts
